offering_description.value: Sells mailing and shipping equipment, software and services to businesses and government agencies. Also provides parcel shipping and delivery services for online merchants, delivered through direct sales, service contracts and cloud platforms.

primary_products.value: postage meters; mailing systems; shipping software; shipping labels

primary_services.value: mail presort; parcel shipping; equipment maintenance

customer_segment.value: B2B: businesses of all sizes, mailing centers, online retailers; B2G: federal and state government agencies

end_markets.value: ecommerce; retail; government; financial services; healthcare

revenue_model.value: product sales: mailing equipment and supplies sold to businesses; rental or leasing: mailing equipment leases to customers; subscription: software and service contracts for mailing and shipping; service fees: mail presort and maintenance services; transaction or usage fees: postage and parcel shipping transactions
revenue_model.category: product sales; rental or leasing; subscription; service fees; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs mailing equipment, sold to businesses and government; software / platform: shipping and mailing software sold to merchants and mailers; service provider: presort and parcel delivery services for mailers and online retailers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: Sells in many countries, with strongest presence in US, Canada, UK and Europe

specialization.value: related lines: mailing equipment, shipping software and ecommerce parcel services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: field sales teams selling to businesses and government; online: cloud shipping software and online ecommerce platform; partners / resellers: channel partners and resellers for equipment and software

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: postal rules such as USPS mailing standards and data privacy laws

notes: Business portfolio has changed over time, so recent divestitures may not be reflected.
